title: Institutional time, named events and phrase binding
summary: TimeInstitutionCalendar governs institutional zone and closures; TimeNamedEvent governs recurring named event and dated exceptions; TimeEventCatalog binds context-qualified phrases and reports ambiguity. The service intentionally does not parse arbitrary natural language or decide that all 'dinner' events mean the same thing.
invariants: Institution and date are explicit required context.
Closures take precedence over event moves; a move cannot reopen a closed institution.
Concurrent meanings produce AMBIGUOUS, not an invented default.
Elapsed event duration is not equivalent to a local end-clock reading across DST.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
